items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Grant Graham in the context of a location ('55 and (Grant Graham) Olive'), but the interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not respond with any personal interaction, relationship, or knowledge of Grant Graham as a person.

ctx.x: NO, this is around 55 and (Grant Graham) Olive, rather. Really around the time when I took my lessons, around 35th and ... So they had a place out there and they had it all draped, all black, you know.
